name: Alpha III
tagline: Ultra High-Speed Industrial Sublimation Transfer Printer

keySpecification.description: Advanced industrial textile printing technology designed to maximize productivity, ensure superior color accuracy, and support diverse fabric applications.

rows.label: Ink Colors

inkCompatibility.description: Designed to support multiple ink technologies, offering flexibility for various fabric types while maintaining exceptional print quality and durability.

inkTypes.name: Sublimation

features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: 12 Epson i3200-A1 Printheads
items.desc: Twelve industrial Epson i3200-A1 heads deliver up to 6,400 lm/day in 1-pass mode, making the Alpha III the highest-output model in the Kolorado Alpha sublimation series for non-stop industrial production.

items.title: Direct Drive Linear Motor System
items.desc: Belt-free, encoder-strip-free direct drive linear motor eliminates mechanical slip and wear, delivering ultra-precise carriage positioning and consistent registration accuracy throughout long production runs.

items.title: Mute Linear Motor Technology
items.desc: High-speed linear motor combined with precision mute rail technology enables fast carriage movement with minimal operational noise, improving working conditions during sustained multi-shift production.

items.title: Negative Pressure Ink Supply System
items.desc: Controlled negative pressure maintains stable, consistent ink flow to all 12 heads throughout the run, preventing pressure fluctuations that cause colour deviation or print quality inconsistencies.

items.title: Vacuum Ink Filtration System
items.desc: Inline vacuum filtration removes air bubbles and ink impurities before they reach the printheads, maintaining top nozzle performance and consistent print quality across extended high-speed production.

items.title: Jumbo Media Roll Support
items.desc: Supports media rolls up to 1,000 metres for extended uninterrupted production runs, significantly reducing roll change frequency and associated downtime on large order batches.

items.title: 200W DC Servo Motor
items.desc: High-torque 200W DC servo motor delivers exceptional movement stability and long-term mechanical reliability, ensuring accurate media transport and consistent output across high-cycle production schedules.

items.title: Up-Down Tension Control System
items.desc: Dual-direction tension control continuously optimises fabric and paper tension from unwind through winding, ensuring smooth, accurate media handling and defect-free output across all media weights.

items.title: Double High-Precision Mute Rail
items.desc: Twin high-precision mute rails enhance carriage stability and structural rigidity, drastically reducing operational vibration to improve overall print quality.

items.title: Lack-of-Media Sensor
items.desc: A simple and clear indicator system that flags the absence of media, preventing dry runs and protecting print quality during continuous production.

items.title: Inflatable Take-up and Feed Media Shaft
items.desc: Inflatable shafts offer a highly efficient way to mount and manage heavy fabric and paper rolls for fast loading and secure, slip-free media handling.

items.title: Rear Media Balance Bar
items.desc: Maintains consistent tension and tracking stability across long production runs for smooth, accurate media feeding.

items.title: Intelligent Dryer Device
items.desc: CMYK drying enhanced with two external infrared units for rapid, thorough ink fixation at production speeds.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Sportswear and Activewear Production at Scale
fabrics.desc: Large-volume sublimation on polyester performance fabrics for major sportswear brands, gym wear manufacturers, and activewear exporters with continuous high-volume order pipelines.
